## v0.5.30: Write targets, vector coverage and sync fixes / 写入目标、向量覆盖与同步修复

Publishes [#398](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/398)–[#407](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/407).

- A memory lands in the Memory Space `mnemon_remember` names, or nowhere, and a write no longer switches a space on by itself (#387). A memory saved without a vector says so (#388).
- **Test status** lists the vectors of every Mnemon Native space, and **Fill in** creates the missing ones through the Host (#392).
- Git sync stops adding Memory Space copies after a merge or a vector fill (#391), no longer fails on untracked SQLite files in its mirror (#396), and keeps one Project Document through the first sync after updating from 0.5.28 (#385).
- Recall past the turn budget says it did not run instead of answering with the previous query's evidence (#389). Tool answers say what they search, which tool or id to use and why a space is out of reach (#390).
- `mnemon_runtime_memory` works beside a second runtime Source (#397), and delegated tasks start with a stable `[dsh-mnemon:delegated …]` line (#393).

发布 [#398](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/398)–[#407](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/407)。

- 记忆写入 `mnemon_remember` 指定的记忆空间，否则不写入；写入不再自行激活空间（#387）。未生成向量的记忆会说明（#388）。
- **测试状态**列出每个 Mnemon Native 空间的向量，**补齐**经由 Host 生成缺少的向量（#392）。
- Git 同步在合并空间或补齐向量后不再多出记忆空间副本（#391），不再因镜像中未跟踪的 SQLite 文件失败（#396），从 0.5.28 更新后的第一次同步也只保留一份项目档案（#385）。
- 超出回合预算的召回会说明没有运行，而不是用上一次查询的证据作答（#389）；工具回答会说明搜索什么、应使用哪个工具或 id，以及空间为何不可达（#390）。
- `mnemon_runtime_memory` 可与第二个运行时 Source 并存（#397），委派任务以固定的 `[dsh-mnemon:delegated …]` 行开头（#393）。

The Starter advances to **0.5.30**, Memory Spaces to **0.5.20** and the Layered strategy to **0.5.9**. The other 15 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration; update every machine that syncs the same repository.

Starter 升至 **0.5.30**，记忆空间升至 **0.5.20**，分层策略升至 **0.5.9**；其余 15 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。同步同一仓库的每台机器都请更新。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH, or install the exact version:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH；也可安装精确版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.30
```

Independently maintained copies in the Profile also need `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.20` or `dsh-mnemon-strategy-default-three-tier@0.5.9`.

Profile 独立维护的副本也需更新到 `dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces@0.5.20` 或 `dsh-mnemon-strategy-default-three-tier@0.5.9`。
